id: title:gesh:open tool report from the error rate chart

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a navigation action and chart interaction to the MCP Analytics dashboard, allowing users to drill down from an error rate chart to a specific tool's quality report while preserving shared filters.
review.reason: The change implements a bounded, substantive capability: adding a click handler and navigation action to the ToolErrorRateChart component. This connects user interaction with the chart to a downstream report, preserving shared filters. This is a clear, bounded improvement to dashboard usability and workflow, not a narrow maintenance change, but not a systemic architectural change.
review.uncertainty: The tier relies on the assumption that this is a dashboard feature rather than a backend-only change; no backend or shared dependency changes are observed, so the relevance is inferred solely from the frontend implementation. No tests or migration helpers are visible in this chunk.

observations.limitations: This chunk represents a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds an action and its implementation to open a tool report, including shared filters and URL construction.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows dashboard users to navigate from the MCP Analytics overview to a specific tool quality report while preserving shared filters, supporting the workflow of investigating tool reliability.

observations.behavior: Adds a click handler and prop to the ToolErrorRateChart component to support the new navigation action.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects the chart's point click interaction to the dashboard's navigation action, enabling users to click a tool row and open its report.

observations.behavior: Adds the onToolClick prop and its handler to the ToolErrorRateChart component.
observations.posthog_connection: Defines the interface for the new click behavior, allowing the chart to accept and invoke the navigation action.
